'''William R. Simpson''' (born July 25, 1966) is an American [[chemistry|chemist]]. He is a pioneer in the field of snow chemistry. He is also a current researcher at [[University of Alaska Fairbanks]]' [[Geophysical Institute]] and [[International Arctic Research Center]] and an associate professor in the chemistry department. He is the principal investigator of the atmospheric chemistry group and director of the university's [[National Science Foundation|NSF]] Research Experience for Undergraduates program.

==Education==
Bill attained his B.A. in chemistry at [[Swarthmore College]] in 1988 and his Ph.D. in physical chemistry at [[Stanford University]] in 1995.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.uaf.edu/chem/faculty/wsimpson/wsimpson.htm |title=Bill Simpson Profile |accessdate=2007-06-13 |archiveurl = https://web.archive.org/web/20070401135653/http://www.uaf.edu/chem/faculty/wsimpson/wsimpson.htm <!-- Bot retrieved archive --> |archivedate = 2007-04-01}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uaf.edu/chem/faculty/wsimpson/wsimpson_cv.pdf |title=Bill Simpson's CV |accessdate=2007-06-13 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080829102644/http://www.uaf.edu/chem/faculty/wsimpson/wsimpson_cv.pdf |archivedate=August 29, 2008 }}</ref>

==Awards==
* CAREER Grant Award of the [[National Science Foundation]] ([[National Science Foundation|NSF]]) 2001-2006 <ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward.do?AwardNumber=0094038 |title=Bill Simpson Career Award |accessdate=2007-06-13}}</ref>
* Research Innovation Award for cavity ring-down spectroscopy, Research Corporation 1999
* Flavored Ice Award for revolutionary snow flavoring techniques

==Research==
* Cavity ring-down spectroscopy
* Snowpack photochemistry
* Stratospheric ozone

==Selected publications==
Simpson has more than 40 papers in peer-reviewed journals.<ref>[http://www.uaf.edu/chem/simpson/docs/Simpson_CV_Sep_07.pdf Microsoft Word - Simpson_CV_Sep_07.doc<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>

* Simpson, W. R., L. Alvarez-Aviles, T. A. Douglas, M. Sturm, and F. Domine (2005), Halogens in the coastal snow pack near Barrow, Alaska: Evidence for active bromine air-snow chemistry during springtime, Geophys. Res. Lett., 32, L04811.
* Ayers, J. D., and W. R. Simpson (2006), Measurements of N<sub>2</sub>O<sub>5</sub> near Fairbanks, Alaska, J. Geophys. Res., 111, D14309.
* Ayers, J. D., R. L. Apodaca, W. R. Simpson, and D. S. Baer (2005), Off-axis cavity ringdown spectroscopy: application to atmospheric nitrate radical detection, Appl. Optics., 44, 7239-7242.
